# Authored browser source

This directory contains authored source and checked-in third-party bundles. Read the [repository map](../docs/repository-map.md) and [feature docs](../docs/README.md) before changing a surface. Do not regenerate, move or delete `dist/` as if it were a build output. [vendor](vendor/) has separate provenance; `downloads/` is generated and may be absent in a fresh checkout.

[index.html](index.html) controls deferred-script dependencies and stylesheet cascade order. Most scripts share globals, DOM IDs and custom events rather than imports. Search existing callers/selectors with `rg` before adding a global or ID. Keep model validation separate from DOM effects where the feature already does so. Refresh a changed asset's content-hash query in the HTML and run [asset-cache checks](../scripts/check-asset-cache.mjs). Preserve intentional API namespaces such as repository preview versus GitHub monitor.

The main state owner is [app.js](app.js); [window.js](window.js) snapshots/transfers workspace state. Preserve saved keys, conversation/pane identities and in-progress input across render, docking and resize. Trace shell input ownership through [shell-input.js](shell-input.js) and [terminal.js](terminal.js); a host-level capture editor must not turn terminal input into a provider prompt. [escape.js](escape.js) is the final dismissal fallback after local dialogs and menus.

Use [bridge.js](bridge.js) for approved native operations, paired with the native receiver. External embeds have a separate trust boundary. Do not enable the legacy development-WebSocket fallback or bypass sign-in to obtain a preview. [The isolated layout fixture](../scripts/fixtures/widget-fit.html) supplies synthetic host responses without real tools. `npm run dev` intentionally serves sign-in/downloads, not the machine-backed workspace.

Package text must render as text; remote content uses the existing sanitization/URL policies. Do not add executable content, raw native methods or credentials to [tool definitions](tools/). Follow [tool authoring](../docs/tools.md) for packages and [the shared model](tools-model.js) for validation. New UI controls require keyboard/Escape/focus behavior and stale-result retirement consistent with their host lifecycle. Run the matching [checks](../scripts/) and `npm run check`; distinguish fixture screenshots from installed native acceptance.
